fields.description: Issue includes local political and civic reporting on Miami city government, including controversy over the proposed appointment of John Rowland as chief of police and coverage of City Clerk Harold E. Ross’s reported shortage and surety bond issues involving former Mayor Ev Sewell, with discussion of grand jury action. Also includes commentary on telephone company rates, warnings about loan sharks and salary buyers, and ongoing promotional coverage of Miami Life’s “Most Attractive Working Girl” beauty contest (featuring Miss Louise Wolfe of the Red Cross Drug Department Store). Regular columns and features include “Round the Town,” “They Tell Me,” and extensive horse-racing tips and racing commission news, along with local society and business notices and advertisements.
